svg.text: Its 27 recipes executed in Hilbert order — a live trace of the run, looping every 30.000000s.
A tile brightens exactly while its recipe emits SVG; the playhead ring rides the Hilbert route; the bar tracks total bytes.
playhead ring = the run's cursor, gliding the Hilbert curve in execution order
red = 2-adic valuation v₂ of the artifact's byte size
blue = 3-adic valuation v₃ of the artifact's byte size
faint line = order-3 Hilbert route; a tile brightens exactly while its recipe runs
progress bar = fraction of total SVG bytes emitted so far (dwell ∝ workload)
27 steps, one per recipe; the run emits 27815435 bytes of SVG over a 30.000000s loop.
Each step's duration is proportional to the bytes it produces (dwell ∝ workload).
Consecutive steps tile the tick axis with no gap/overlap (steps_timeline_partitions).
The trace ends exactly at the total byte count (steps_covers_totalOut) and strictly advances (steps_strictly_monotone).
Machine-checked by native_decide; the animation is a faithful picture of the verified trace.
